description: A stainless urn on a hotplate, a sleeve of paper cups beside it, and a brown ring baked into the drip tray so thoroughly it has become a feature of the tray. The coffee in it was made at some point. It's hot and it's here at four in the morning.

flags.aliases: urn, coffee, coffee machine, pot, hot water, cups, cup
flags.vend_line: You pull a paper cup off the stack beside the urn. It comes away with two others stuck inside it, and you put those back.

name: coffee urn
